+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd
+
+
+OUT = Path("out")
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+
+conn = duckdb.connect()
+crashes = conn.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM crash_date)::INTEGER AS weekday_num, COUNT(*) AS crash_count
+    FROM read_parquet('data/crashes.parquet')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY weekday_num
+    """
+).df()
+
+weekdays = pd.DataFrame(
+    {
+        "weekday_num": range(1, 8),
+        "weekday": ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"],
+    }
+)
+values = weekdays.merge(crashes, on="weekday_num", how="left")
+calendar_days = pd.date_range("2013-01-01", "2025-12-31", freq="D")
+calendar_counts = pd.Series(calendar_days.dayofweek + 1).value_counts().sort_index()
+values["calendar_days"] = values["weekday_num"].map(calendar_counts).astype(int)
+values["share_of_crashes_pct"] = values["crash_count"] / values["crash_count"].sum() * 100
+values["crashes_per_calendar_day"] = values["crash_count"] / values["calendar_days"]
+
+plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 11, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
+for option_id, metric, ylabel, title, filename, formatter in [
+    (1, "crash_count", "Police-reported crashes", "NYC crashes by weekday (2013–2025)", "values_1.csv", lambda v: f"{v:,.0f}"),
+    (2, "crashes_per_calendar_day", "Average crashes per calendar date", "Average NYC crashes per weekday date (2013–2025)", "values_2.csv", lambda v: f"{v:,.1f}"),
+]:
+    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.4))
+    bars = ax.bar(values["weekday"], values[metric], color="#377eb8")
+    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
+    ax.set_title(title, pad=16, weight="bold")
+    ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=20)
+    for bar, val in zip(bars, values[metric]):
+        ax.annotate(formatter(val), (bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, bar.get_height()),
+                    xytext=(0, 4), textcoords="offset points", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=9)
+    fig.tight_layout()
+    fig.savefig(OUT / f"option_{option_id}.png", dpi=160, bbox_inches="tight")
+    plt.close(fig)
+    values[["weekday", "weekday_num", metric, "calendar_days", "share_of_crashes_pct"]].to_csv(
+        OUT / filename, index=False, float_format="%.6f"
+    )
+
+print(values.to_string(index=False, formatters={
+    "share_of_crashes_pct": "{:.4f}%".format,
+    "crashes_per_calendar_day": "{:.3f}".format,
+}))
+print("Total crashes:", int(values["crash_count"].sum()))
*** End Patch
